Orders, executions, positions, holdings and new portfolio master exist. Portfolio master maps client to portfolio; no separate portfolio valuation snapshot is included.

Orders, executions, clients, products, sectors, dates and charges support most metrics. Sector comes from enriched instrument master/sector_mapping. Average order value definition should be documented.
3b_trade_quotes.csv has spread and slippage fields; execution timestamps support delay. Tick market data with quotes is also included.

Holdings and positions support latest valuation and P&L fields; transaction ledger/dividends support additional P&L. Daily/MTD/YTD portfolio P&L requires dated snapshots/valuation logic and should not be assumed complete.

Historical OHLCV, benchmark index and risk-free-rate datasets support return volatility, beta and Sharpe proxies. Portfolio-level drawdown and concentration require a dated portfolio value series; only holdings history/positions history provide snapshots.

Historical OHLCV supports return, volume, turnover (close × volume), volatility, range and moving-average features. Thresholds must be configurable. Turnover Z-score can be missing for initial rolling-window rows.
Client, orders, executions, products, sectors and holdings history support frequency, size, buy/sell and preferences. Holding period is approximate unless position-lot linkage is available.
Brokerage charges and transaction ledger support charges/net cash-flow analysis; taxes and other charges are itemized in brokerage file. Gross realized P&L needs a consistent lot/accounting method.
Corporate actions and dividends exist. Need corporate-action-adjusted positions/transaction history around each event to prove before/after quantity and value reconciliation.
Historical OHLCV and order/execution/charges date history support time series. Forecast quality depends on daily aggregation and limited recent trading history.
Datasets cover most Market, Trading, Portfolio, Client and Operations sections. AUM and settlement issues depend on clear valuation/cash-ledger definitions.
Order rejection, settlement cash ledger, reconciliation outputs and data quality checks support drill-through exceptions; thresholds must be configured.
Files are included, but some source columns intentionally contain nulls (e.g. transaction ledger, quote sizes, holdings history); inspect before modeling.
